headerDisplay: Integrates Texecom Premier / Premier Elite panels via the Crestron protocol over a serial cable (PC-COM / USB-COM) or COM-IP. Configure **either** a serial device **or** an IP address.
footerDisplay: Arm/disarm from HomeKit requires the panel's UDL code and supports areas 1–8.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Homebridge log. You shouldn't need to change this.

protocol.title: Connection type

oneOf.title: Crestron (serial cable, ComIP or SmartCom with its COM port set to "Crestron System")
Texecom Connect (SmartCom or ComIP left in its normal mode)

protocol.description: Connect needs a Premier Elite on firmware v4 or later. It discovers zones and areas automatically, reports arm modes precisely and has no delay after arming from HomeKit. While connected, the official Texecom app can't use that module.

ip_address.title: IP Address
ip_address.description: Address of the ComIP/SmartCom (or serial-to-IP bridge). Leave blank when using a serial cable.

ip_port.title: IP Port
ip_port.description: Crestron: the bridge's port. Connect: the module's UDL port (usually 10001).

serial_device.title: Serial Device
serial_device.description: Leave blank when using an IP connection.

udl.title: UDL Code
udl.description: The panel's UDL code. Required for Connect, and for arming/disarming from HomeKit with Crestron.

zones.title: Zones

dwell.title: Dwell Time (ms)
dwell.description: How long the sensor stays active after the panel reports the zone has cleared.

zones.description: Optional with Connect: if no zones or areas are listed, they are read from the panel.

area_number.title: Area Number
area_number.description: Areas above 8 report status only; they cannot be armed from HomeKit.

zones.title: Zones in this Area
zones.description: Zone numbers in this area. Only used with "Show alarm from zone activity".

remote_users.title: Remote / Keyfob Users
remote_users.description: Panel user numbers that arm using a remote or keyfob. An arm by one of these users is always shown as Away in HomeKit.

default_arm_state.title: Default Arm State
default_arm_state.description: What to show in HomeKit when an area is armed by any other user, at a keypad for example. The panel does not report whether an arm was full or part, so this is a best guess.

trigger_from_zones.title: Show alarm from zone activity
trigger_from_zones.description: Mark an away-armed area as triggered as soon as one of its zones goes active (outside the entry delay). Off by default: the panel reports real alarms itself. Only turn this on if your panel does not.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log every message from the panel without enabling Homebridge-wide debug mode.

part_arm_1.title: Part Arm 1 shows in HomeKit as

part_arm_2.title: Part Arm 2 shows in HomeKit as

part_arm_3.title: Part Arm 3 shows in HomeKit as

night_part_arm.title: HomeKit Night uses part arm
night_part_arm.description: Crestron only, area 1: the part arm (1-3) that Night sets. Empty = Part Arm 1.

home_part_arm.title: HomeKit Home uses part arm
home_part_arm.description: Crestron only, area 1: the part arm (1-3) that Home sets. Empty = Part Arm 1, the same as Night.

homekit_modes.title: Arm modes shown in the Home app
homekit_modes.description: Which buttons the Home app offers besides Off. Leave empty for all three (Away, Night, Home). Changing this doesn't change the panel, only the choices shown.

status_poll_interval.title: Status check (seconds)
status_poll_interval.description: Crestron only: how often to ask the panel which areas are armed (ASTATUS). Corrects HomeKit after a missed arm/disarm event, and reconnects if the panel stops answering for three checks in a row. 0 = only after connecting.

time_sync_interval.title: Panel clock check (hours)
time_sync_interval.description: Connect only: how often to compare the panel clock with this machine's and correct it if it's more than a minute out (also checked shortly after connecting). 0 = off. Same option as upstream 4.4.

layout.title: Arm modes in the Home app
layout.description:
The Home app shows an Off button plus up to three arm modes. What each one does on the panel:
• Away: full arm.
• Night: Crestron, the part arm chosen below, or Part Arm 1 if none; Connect, the part arm mapped to Night.
• Home: Crestron, the part arm chosen below, or Part Arm 1 if none (so the same as Night unless you change it); Connect, the part arm mapped to Home.
Choose only the modes you use, so the Home app doesn't offer buttons that do the same thing.
